content: Since LocalStack 2026.03.0 the unified image requires LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN to start at all (even free Hobby/non-commercial tier requires account registration); official docker-compose sample sets environment LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN=${LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN:?} (fails fast if unset), ports 4566 and 4510-4559, volumes for /var/lib/localstack and the docker socket.
